description: Source code for a base class and supporting components of a Python code linter, including error display and file processing logic.

classes.name: ErrorLines
classes.description: Defines how many lines to display before and after an error in linting results.

classes.name: FileLinter
classes.description: Base class for token-based Python code linters, providing core functionality for linting, file handling, and result display.

methods.name: _lint
methods.description: Abstract method to perform linting on a PythonFile, to be implemented by subclasses.

methods.name: __init__
methods.description: Initializes the FileLinter with command-line arguments and sets up the argument parser.

methods.name: run
methods.description: Class method to instantiate and run the linter, exiting with status code.

methods.name: lint_all
methods.description: Runs linting on all files specified in the arguments.

methods.name: make_file
methods.description: Creates a PythonFile object for a given path.

methods.name: args
methods.description: Cached property that parses and returns command-line arguments.

methods.name: code
methods.description: Returns the uppercase name of the linter.

methods.name: paths
methods.description: Returns a sorted list of file paths to be linted based on command-line arguments.

methods.name: _lint_file
methods.description: Performs linting on a single file, handling output and fixes.

methods.name: _error
methods.description: Handles files that are unparsable during linting.

methods.name: _replace
methods.description: Performs recursive linting and replacement on a PythonFile, returning the modified content and results.

methods.name: _display
methods.description: Generates human-readable output for linting results.

methods.name: _display_window
methods.description: Displays a window of source code around an error for context.
